description: This file defines the DealList component and related layout components for managing and displaying a list of deals within a React-Admin based interface. It handles conditional rendering based on URL matches, provides filters and actions, and integrates various subcomponents for deal operations.

methods.name: DealList
methods.description: Main component that retrieves user identity and renders DealLayout with specific list configurations.

methods.name: DealLayout
methods.description: Handles routing logic, filters, and conditional UI rendering for deal list, including creation, editing, viewing, and empty states.

methods.name: DealActions
methods.description: Defines the toolbar with actions such as filter, export, and create new deal.
